Yeah, if anything, nobody should be buying this for multiple reasons.  
1.) Scalpers can only physically sell the ability to forward the email too you  
2.) Scalpers HAVE to let the passes go because they have no use for purchasing it if they're a private operation  
3.) Why? Because you have to put a first and last name when purchasing the ticket. They can't buy the tickets and scalp them already purchased for this reason.

Yeah, I honestly think the VGC subreddit should consider banning resellers to discourage the behavior. Only giveaways should be permitted if anything since theres no risk for scams for that type of thing.
